title: Haunted Walking Tour of Mill Avenue
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Mill Ave Ghost Tours is Tempe's only old-world style history, true crime, and paranormal walking tour! Guests will be educated and entertained by local costumed guides who are trained by research historians to separate fact from fiction... because believe us, the real stories are MUCH more horrifying than myth. These keepers of nearly forgotten lore walk by lantern light to at least seven different sites throughout the evening, each with their own sordid tale. We guarantee you'll learn something new before the night is out, but good luck sleeping afterwards!
